title: Dolphins Down Under
specs: Custom-built twin hull glass bottom catamarans with four large glass panels for underwater viewing
High success rate of wild dolphin sightings
Opportunity to see osprey, great blue herons, stingrays, sea turtles, and other marine life
Children 8 years and under must wear life jackets by US Coast Guard
Respectful dress code required; swimwear not permitted without cover-up; men must wear shirts at all times
Wheelchair accessibility very limited; gravel parking lot and stairs to dock and vessel

blurb: Guests join dolphin cruises or sunset cruises on custom-built glass bottom catamarans to view wild dolphins and other marine life. The boats have four large glass panels for underwater viewing. Cruises include opportunities to see dolphins, osprey, herons, stingrays, sea turtles, and more.
extraNote: Reservations recommended; require full deposit; deposit nonrefundable within 48 hours of trip · Arrive 30 minutes before scheduled departure; boat departs on time · Guarantee to see dolphins or offer rain check for next cruise if no dolphins sighted · No strollers, infant carriers, or car seats allowed onboard · No outside coolers or beverages allowed; drinks available for purchase onboard · Motion sickness unlikely due to stable catamaran and calm waters; medication recommended if needed · Caribe Marina
